Resource Profile: Spirometry Observation

Official URL: http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/StructureDefinition/spirometry-observation Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2026-11-26 Computable Name: SpirometryObservation
Other Identifiers: OID:2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.40.54.42.36

The result of one spirometry session (one sitting, typically 3 to 8 forced manoeuvres) performed by the patient at home. Following the ATS/ERS 2019 reporting rules, the reported FEV1 and FVC are the largest values from the acceptable manoeuvres (they may come from different manoeuvres), and each is accompanied by its session quality grade. Individual manoeuvres are not exchanged.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Observation/SpirometryExample and Observation/SpirometryExample2

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
spiro-fev1-grade warning Observation The ATS/ERS grade of the reported FEV1 SHOULD be reported. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fev1-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-grade warning Observation If FVC is reported, its ATS/ERS grade SHOULD be reported as well. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-required error Observation FEV1/FVC, FEF25-75, FVC % predicted and the FVC grade can only be reported together with FVC. component.where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '19926-5' or code = '19927-3' or code = '19872-1')) or (system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade')).exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists()

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
spiro-fev1-grade warning Observation The ATS/ERS grade of the reported FEV1 SHOULD be reported. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fev1-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-grade warning Observation If FVC is reported, its ATS/ERS grade SHOULD be reported as well. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-required error Observation FEV1/FVC, FEF25-75, FVC % predicted and the FVC grade can only be reported together with FVC. component.where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '19926-5' or code = '19927-3' or code = '19872-1')) or (system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade')).exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
spiro-fev1-grade warning Observation The ATS/ERS grade of the reported FEV1 SHOULD be reported. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fev1-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-grade warning Observation If FVC is reported, its ATS/ERS grade SHOULD be reported as well. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-required error Observation FEV1/FVC, FEF25-75, FVC % predicted and the FVC grade can only be reported together with FVC. component.where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '19926-5' or code = '19927-3' or code = '19872-1')) or (system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade')).exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
spiro-fev1-grade warning Observation The ATS/ERS grade of the reported FEV1 SHOULD be reported. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fev1-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-grade warning Observation If FVC is reported, its ATS/ERS grade SHOULD be reported as well. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-required error Observation FEV1/FVC, FEF25-75, FVC % predicted and the FVC grade can only be reported together with FVC. component.where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '19926-5' or code = '19927-3' or code = '19872-1')) or (system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade')).exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
spiro-fev1-grade warning Observation The ATS/ERS grade of the reported FEV1 SHOULD be reported. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fev1-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-grade warning Observation If FVC is reported, its ATS/ERS grade SHOULD be reported as well. component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade').exists()).exists()
spiro-fvc-required error Observation FEV1/FVC, FEF25-75, FVC % predicted and the FVC grade can only be reported together with FVC. component.where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '19926-5' or code = '19927-3' or code = '19872-1')) or (system = 'http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/spirometry-component-codes' and code = 'fvc-grade')).exists()).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '19870-5').exists()).exists()
